description: fs.watch over an overwrite, as Node 22 reports it on Linux, where every watch of a program shares one inotify queue and inotify merges an event only with the same one just before it: a recursive watch reports an overwrite twice (the file's truncate and write, each after its directory's), a watch on the file once, an empty overwrite and an append once each; two watchers on one file share its watch and hear each event in the order they were started; a file's watch hears an event after its directory's
